review.deduplication: Only identical source, translation, rubric anchors and preservation checks share two reviews; every receipt separately hash-bound.
review.empty_failures: zero score by frozen rubric; no invented dimension review

engineering.scope: Actual Codex source/target reading of all risk pairs plus seeded20%/all-serious audit; remaining pairs retain two real low model passes.

descriptive_methods.basis: Existing frozen corpus metadata; no numerical quality judgments generated. Descriptive views do not replace preregistered full240 paired primary comparisons.
descriptive_methods.other_views: All domain/origin/split/length/existing-tag categories and positive/zero/unknown reported reasoning. Tag groups overlap; reported-reasoning groups are difficulty-confounded.
descriptive_methods.dimension_denominator: Actually reviewed translations only; empty failures count0 in overall quality but have no invented dimension scores.
descriptive_methods.usage: Known token subtotals and missing counts; normalized by all corresponding original characters including whitespace.

limitations: Account output limit is not controlled by the existing plugin adapter.
Provider routes, hidden defaults, caching and account metering are not independently controlled.
Common adapter instructions are mapped to Command system/instructions; this is a new comparison cohort.
Dataset holdout previously exposed; non-independent engineering review.

One administratively interrupted GPT Responses none request has an unknown outcome and a preregistered replacement. Original request remains in the ledger; its sample is excluded from GPT paired latency comparisons.
The original plugin client exposes requested/catalogue model identity but no returned backend model name; native response_model is therefore unknown.
accounting_note: Command uses archived provider token-price snapshots, including separately reported cache writes. Subscription cash and quota percentage unknown. API equivalents and product fees are estimates; unreported write counters or surcharges are not inferred. Missing receipts are excluded and counted.
